messages:
jordan: Quick design sync: I pushed a tiny prototype for a CIDR helper that appears when users paste or type a single IPv4 address in the Private setup wizard. Figma clip: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE. Proposal: show a low-contrast overlay suggestion (e.g., suggest '/24') instead of inserting text inline. It should be dismissible, keyboard-accessible, and avoid layout shift.

mina: Love the overlay approach. Two immediate concerns: 1) mobile keyboard covers bottom controls so the overlay should float above inputs, not push layout; 2) animation must respect reduce-motion.

oliver: Agree on overlay. Technical notes: overlay should be positioned absolutely within the input container and use transform for appearance to avoid reflow. If overlay is focusable it must not capture Tab by default. We can add a visually hidden live region announcing 'Recommended subnet: 10.1.0.0/24' when suggestion appears.

lucy: Copy thoughts: main label 'Recommended subnet (editable)' with secondary microcopy 'Click to apply' works. For tiny viewports use 'Subnet (rec)'. Error copy when suggestion conflicts: 'That range overlaps a reserved network. Try 10.1.1.0/24 or choose a different subnet.' Keep it actionable and example-driven.

jordan: Accessibility nit: suggestion must be reachable by keyboard (tab or arrow) and announced, but it shouldn't trap focus. Pressing Enter applies suggestion; Esc dismisses. Also screen readers should get a short, non-technical explanation for why /24 is suggested.

aria-bot: a11y checklist: 1) aria-live='polite' region for announcement; 2) suggestion element tabindex=0 and role='button'; 3) visible focus indicator; 4) Esc closes popover; 5) ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 for text within the chip.

oliver: Implementation snippet idea:
```
.input-wrapper{position:relative;}
.suggest-overlay{position:absolute;right:8px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%) scale(1);background:#f9fafb;border:1px solid #e6edf3;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;box-shadow:none;}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){.suggest-overlay{transition:none;}}
```
Make icon aria-hidden and use a semantic button for the action.

mina: UX microflow: 1) user types/pastes '10.1.2.3' -> overlay appears saying 'Recommend 10.1.2.0/24'; 2) if user types more (e.g., '/16') overlay hides; 3) if user presses ArrowRight while caret inside input, overlay highlights but Tab still moves forward. Add a tiny '?' that opens a short popover: 'Why /24? Balances reachability and routing simplicity.' Popover must be keyboard dismissible.

lucy: Short tooltip (for icon): 'Why /24? Most customer subnets are /24; reduces accidental giant ranges.' Long doc blurb for docs repo: 200 chars explaining reasoning and edge cases.

jordan: Telemetry: product wants to know acceptance rate for suggestion. Proposal: emit a boolean event 'cidr_suggestion_accepted=true/false' with no raw IPs. For hosted, event defaults on; for Private deployments, default-off and opt-in via admin console. Must be documented in privacy policy.

oliver: We'll implement the event as a hashed action flag + deployment scope. Backend will not store raw hostnames or IPs; only the boolean and anonymized metadata. Make sure audits pass for Private installs.

aria-bot: privacy checklist: 1) no raw IPs in hosted logs; 2) hashed or omitted in Private by default; 3) telemetry opt-in UI must be clear; 4) include a config knob for compliance teams.

pr-bot: Reminder: when opening the PR, tag 'a11y-impact' if tab order changes, and include the a11y checklist in the PR description. Also attach the Figma frames for overlay/inline variants.

jordan: Action items: mina to update Figma with overlay + inline fallback by EOD, lucy to paste short/long copy variants, oliver to prototype CSS/keyboard behavior, and i'll open a ticket with acceptance criteria (keyboard nav, live region, telemetry flag defaults). We'll run a short a11y lab Wednesday 10am PT. Thanks!
